description: Olwateso lulimi olw’aba Nilotic, olwogerwa abantu abasoba obukade bubiri mu buvanjuba bwa Uganda: e Soroti, Kumi, Serere n’e Amuria, era n’Abateso abali e Kenya.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. The Lusoga needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/teo).

why.title: Olulimi lw’e **Soroti, Kumi n’enyanja dh’e Teso.**
why.text: Olwateso luli mu kika kya Ateker n’Olukaramoja n’Oluturukana, atyanu bw’oluyiga oigula enimi inhi okuva mu Uganda okutuuka e Kenya ne South Sudan. Luyige olw’ab’eka, entambula, emirimu, n’enyimba, amazina n’engero dh’e Teso.

cards.title: Ku lw’ab’eka
cards.text: Yogera ne badhaadha n’ab’eka e Soroti ne Kumi.

cards.title: Ku lw’abatambuli
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Soroti okutuuka e Kumi, Ngora ne ku nyanja Bisina.

cards.title: Ku lw’abeegomba okumanya
cards.text: Bona olulimi lwa Nilotic oluliko amanya ag’ekikazi n’ekisadha, era nga teruliko bika bya manya.

landing.audience: Aboogera Olusoga abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’eka abava mu Teso, n’abatambuli abagenda e Soroti.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’enamba, oluvanyuma ab’omu maka, emere, akatale, esaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Olwateso nga tanaba kutambula
